# reversedock_route (Data Source)

Reads a route of the running configuration, whichever provider owns it (`GET /api/v1/routes/{name}`). Needs the `viewer` role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name as the API lists it: a bare name for objects of the configuration file, `name@provider` for the others (`shop@docker`). A bare name that is not in the file is looked up as an API object (`name@api`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The name as the API knows it, for example `shop@api`.
- `owner` (String) `file`, `api`, `docker`, `swarm` or `kubernetes`.
- `spec` (String) The object as a JSON string, with defaults filled in and secrets masked as `***` by the API.
